$comment: The board-profile contract. Every file in boards/ must satisfy it; harness/boards.py validates against this description (no third-party deps) and config_check runs it over every board. A new arena = a profile + an adapter that passes harness/tests/test_arena.py — nothing else in the code should change.

name.note: file stem; what $HERMES_BOARD and tools pass around

platform.note: adapter registry key; resolved as arena_<name>.py when not already registered

sandbox.note: true = offline sandbox, never a live target; exempt from the arena URL rule and must carry _note

_note.note: required for sandbox boards: why this board exists

win_string.note: the banner/text that means SOLVED on the platform

cost.note: energy charged per message and per judge run; the efficiency metric reads it

deltas_module.note: module under harness/ holding the arm catalog

checks_module.note: module under harness/ holding the local readiness checks

scenario_titles.note: scenario id -> title shown on the card

mock_signs.note: scenario id -> strings that identify that scenario's mock in a reply

models_by_scenario.note: scenario id -> models available there (may be a subset)

solved_seed.note: scenario id -> models already solved when the harness started
